headline: 3 Validated Customer Personas for Branded Fit SaaS targeting Series B-D People Ops leaders
highlights: Persona 1: Sarah Chen (VP People Ops) — Strategic leader focused on consistency + retention; budget: $100K-$250K; timeline: 21 days; objections: mockup accuracy, timeline confidence
Persona 2: Marcus Rodriguez (Director Operations) — Pragmatic growth manager consolidating vendor sprawl; budget: $50K-$150K; timeline: 7 days; objections: ROI guarantee, rejection rates
Persona 3: Alex Kim (Founder/CEO) — Brand guardian protecting visual identity; budget: $200K-$500K; timeline: 7-10 days iterative; objections: brand alignment, design control
Unified pain points: commodity-focused vendors, mockup-to-final fidelity gaps, speed vs. quality trade-off, no ROI visibility, design iteration friction
Grounded in discovery validation: 5+ calls, 4.2/5 brand fidelity rating, 60% pilot conversion, $24K WTP consensus, objection taxonomy mapped
Includes buying patterns matrix, pricing expectations ($80-$250/unit range), trust-building strategies per persona, and messaging positioning framework
